scope: Expansion of the Key terms and phrases sections in every cataloged study guide. Normalized guide hashes include complete guide contents. Objective hashes cover the exact retained bytes.
review: Coordinator editorial review and separate fresh-context AI review in 25 packets. Definitions were checked against teaching passages with selective first-party source checks. Human review, live product verification and full-guide audits were outside the scope.

review_scope.verification: The coordinator checked section placement and semantic fit. Separate reviewers compared final guide and objective hashes, inspected incremental changes and identified incorrect definitions, near-duplicates and thin coverage. Technical source checks were selective.

final_review_groups.coverage: Network, security, operating systems and Splunk
Programming, analytics, enterprise software, Oracle, Google Cloud, HashiCorp, Salesforce and ServiceNow

review_scope.supplemental_check: A second reviewer independently examined 26 later additions in 12 guides and rechecked the two corrected Databricks definitions. The retained guide hashes identify the final text.
